_doc: MISUMI's Center Joint HMJ5 for its 5 series (20 mm, 6 mm slot): a centre post whose head lies in b's slot and whose shank goes into a's centre bore, held by a joint guide in an M hole drilled across a 10 mm from its end and tightened by an M4x8 set screw. Sizes from MISUMI's 2014 catalogue; it prints no price.
name: fitting-misumi-hmj5

fitting_kind.rule: An anchor (centre) joint: its post in a's end, its head in b's slot, held by a guide in a hole drilled across a

bending_stiffness.rule: How stiffly this centre joint, its set screw tight, holds a beam's end against turning across its axis, its screws tight. The maker gives no figure, so this is frames' working guess for this kind of join (JOIN_STIFFNESS.anchor), until the joint rig measures it
bending_stiffness.source: A working guess of @rulecad/frames, with no measurement or published figure behind it: the joint rig (issue 264) measures it and cad measured replaces it

twist_stiffness.rule: How stiffly this centre joint, its set screw tight, holds a beam's end against twisting about its own axis. The maker gives no figure, so this is frames' working guess (JOIN_STIFFNESS.anchor), until the joint rig measures it
twist_stiffness.source: A working guess of @rulecad/frames, with no measurement or published figure behind it: the joint rig (issue 264) measures it and cad measured replaces it
